summary.text: Accumulated Soil Mountain is an earth path immortal killer move with formation path effect. Wu Shuai obtains it from Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress during dream realm exploration.

claims.text: After repeated explorations of the dream realm, Wu Shuai learns the general information of Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress and gains its three killer moves: accumulated soil mountain, peaceful burial, and heavy soil comeback. The first is the one that opens his eyes. It has no offense, movement, healing, or other such aspects. The user can stack earth path Gu worms into an Immortal Gu House even with zero formation path attainment, and that is why this fortress exists. Gaining the killer move is gaining the foundation of the house. Wu Shuai cannot find a core Immortal Gu because the core is accumulated soil mountain itself. He then activates it and adds earth path Gu worms to repair the damaged house while enduring Ghost Spirit Ice Silkworm Tribulation. Peaceful burial and heavy soil comeback are the other two house killer moves, not this stacking method.

Fang Yuan takes out rank eight Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress in battle. The earth path house has three core killer moves rather than a core Immortal Gu, and accumulated soil mountain is the most important. Each such fortress can look different, and even one fortress can change form and abilities when different earth path Gu worms are used.

After Spectral Soul’s fused soul explosion leaves the fortress thirty percent shorter, with a damaged surface but no holes, Fang Yuan injects immortal essence inside the house and activates Accumulated Soil Mountain. Countless earth path Gu worms fly up from the sovereign immortal aperture and enter the house. After three breaths the fortress recovers fully and its appearance changes from round to a tower with edges and sharp corners. Because the core is immortal killer moves, added earth path Gu worms merge with high stability and can alter the tower’s properties, so Spectral Soul and Demon Immortal Qi Jue have to start their probe over.
